descricao.pt: Provas de vestibular da UNICAMP e da USP, com metadados por assunto, para avaliar modelos em português.
descricao.en: Entrance exams from UNICAMP and USP, with subject metadata, to evaluate models in Portuguese.

fontes.trecho: we introduce the Brazilian Leading Universities Entrance eXams (BLUEX), a dataset of entrance exams from the two leading universities in Brazil: UNICAMP and USP
